artworks.title: Le séduira-t-il? Les Paris sont ouverts
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image displays two figures from head to toe. The person on the left has dark hair tied back, wearing a dress and crown, standing with a hand on the hip. The figure on the right is taller, wearing a crown, cape, and boots, leaning towards the first person and holding their hand. In the background, two groups of soldiers face each other with rifles and bayonets. The setting seems to be a public place or arena with onlookers.

artworks.title: David Playing before Saul
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in various poses. The central figure is a man with an athletic build, shown in full body. He is slightly turned to the side, looking over his shoulder towards the group behind him. He has short, curly dark hair and is wearing a short, striped cloth wrapped around his waist. He carries a quiver of arrows slung over his shoulder and a bow in his other hand. Surrounding him are several other individuals; an older man with long hair and a beard raising his arm, a seated woman in a flowing dress with a prominent belt, and several other figures in the background, some wearing armor and helmets. The environment is reminiscent of a grand, ancient setting, possibly a hall with large arches and columns. The foreground includes a kneeling young person handling an incense burner from which smoke rises, and various ornaments and vessels are scattered around. The entire scene is captured in a monochromatic, shaded style typical of graphite or charcoal drawings.

artworks.title: Un léger zéphir annoncant l'arrivée du printemps
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures struggling against the wind. The image depicts strong gusts of wind causing the clothing of the figures to billow dramatically. One figure is on the left, wearing a voluminous dress, while the figure on the right is wearing a heavy coat and holding onto their hat. A hat is seen flying off into the air. The artistic style is reminiscent of 19th-century caricature work, with exaggerated features and expressions.

artworks.title: A Spanish Holiday, Granada
artworks.medium: etching in black on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a view through a large architectural archway with figures engaged in various activities. The perspective is from a position close to the street level, looking towards the archway. The archway is the focal point due to its darkened interior and decorative detailing. The horizon is not distinct, as the architectural elements dominate the upper portion. The brushstroke technique is sketch-like with cross-hatching and vertical strokes, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray against a light background. Closest to us is a man sitting beside a street post, drawing the eye into the scene. Groups of people walk and gather in the distance, adding to the sense of an active urban environment.

artworks.title: Ce Monsieur Courbet, fait des figures ... vulgaires ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows six individuals engaged in conversation. The main focal point is on a middle-aged man wearing a top hat and a suit with a bowtie, reaching his hand out. He is surrounded by another man to his right and another man to his left, who is holding a hat. To the right of these central figures is a woman wearing a bonnet and shawl. All individuals are depicted in a rough sketch style with exaggerated expressions. The background includes smaller figures wearing similar hats and coats, indicating a gathering or event. Text at the top reads "L'EXPOSITION UNIVERSELLE."

artworks.title: Descendant joyeusement le fleuve de la vie
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a boat on a serene waterway. Several people are lounging on the boat in various relaxed positions. One person is standing in the center, drinking from a bottle. The others are reclining or sprawled out, creating an atmosphere of leisure. The water underneath reflects the figures. In the background, there is a faint outline of a building and some trees on the shore. The drawing is in a monochrome style with effective use of light and shadow. French text at the top and bottom provides additional context.

artworks.title: Vue prise aux bains a quatre sous
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a swimming pool with many people close together, only their upper bodies visible. The people have different hairstyles and some wear swimming caps. One person holds a child. There are walls in the background and a textured overhead area, possibly indicating an indoor location.

artworks.title: Je crois que je tiens un lièvre ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a man pointing with a stick towards dense foliage. The man has distinct facial features including a pointed nose and prominent jawline, wearing a tall hat. He is dressed in a heavy coat, a patterned scarf, and checkered pants, with simple shoes on his feet. In the background are trees and foliage, creating a forest-like setting. A hare can be seen around the tree near the man. The style is sketchy with heavy shading, and there are no visible jewelry or prominent objects in the image.

artworks.title: Je viens prévenir le roi Agamemnon ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: Three men in a room. Two men seated at a table holding fans of playing cards. One man has long hair, wearing a wreath-like accessory on his head and draped clothing. The other man has short, dark hair and wears a dark suit. Cards scattered on the table between them. A third man standing in the background near an open doorway, with short hair and a long coat. A blank wall with a square picture frame and a circular object hanging on it in the background.

artworks.title: Scène d'Hippophagie
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a dining room. The man is seated at a round table, examining food in his hand. He wears glasses, a coat, and a towel hangs from his lap. The woman stands next to him, holding a plate. There is a bottle, a loaf of bread, and a plate with food on the table. A dog is lying on the ground by the man's feet, reaching towards a bone. There is a painting of a zebra on the wall behind them.

artworks.title: Charon
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boatman with a figure on the shore. The boatman is in a small wooden boat with oars in the water. A standing unclothed figure is on the shore, possibly gesturing or beckoning. The background includes a textured, hilly landscape blending with the shoreline. The drawing style features careful detailing and use of light and shadow, creating a dramatic and mythological atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Burrow Train, New Mexico
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with donkeys carrying loads, led by figures. The viewpoint appears slightly elevated, with a horizon line placed about a quarter of the way from the top. The sky is clear with some clouds. The scene is depicted using fine, detailed, cross-hatched lines, typical of etchings. Closest to us, donkeys laden with barrels and boxes walk along a dirt path. Further away, the path leads into hilly terrain with more figures and cargo. The color palette is monochrome, primarily black and grey shades, emphasizing texture and contrast.

artworks.title: Dockside Scene
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Josephine Boardman Crane, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a port scene with a large ship in the background. Various figures and items are depicted on what appears to be a dock or ship deck. A large ship with tall masts is visible in the background. The drawing captures scattered items and details, potentially indicating a scene of embarkation or arrival. The lines and shading convey movement and anticipation. An American flag is seen atop one of the ships.

artworks.title: John Marshall
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in profile, facing to the right. He has pronounced facial features with a distinctive nose and chin. His hair is styled back neatly, and he is wearing a high-collared garment with a white cravat or necktie around his neck. The background is plain and muted. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands. The image includes text and signatures.

artworks.title: Solitude
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. Theodore R. Spector, 1949)
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a row of tall, slender trees at the center, their twisting branches reaching upwards. The horizon is low, with the tree tops silhouetted against the sky. The brushstrokes are intricate, creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of brown. A path leads through the grass towards the trees, which seem to border a body of water.

artworks.title: Green River, Wyoming Territory
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated position, featuring a river flowing into the distance. A rugged mesa dominates the high horizon, with another rock formation to the left creating a frame for the scene. Trees line the water's edge, contrasting with the rock formations. Swirling clouds fill the sky above. The illustration uses fine lines and cross-hatching for detail and depth, resembling an etching. The color scheme is limited to sepia tones, giving the image a tranquil, vintage aesthetic. Reeds and grasses grow along the riverbank, leading the gaze towards the central mesa.

artworks.title: Sunrise—The Pond, Easthampton, Long Island
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a dirt path leading to a bridge over water, surrounded by reeds and grass. The horizon is low with a sun and clouds in the sky. The image is detailed, featuring fine lines and shading. The color scheme is sepia and black, creating an antique atmosphere. In the distance, there is marshland and trees leading to the horizon.

artworks.title: Sunrise—The Pond, Easthampton, Long Island
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape seen from a slightly elevated perspective. A winding dirt path leads towards a small bridge near a marshy body of water. The horizon is located about one-third from the top of the image where a line of hills, trees, and a vast sky can be seen. In the sky, the sun is either setting or rising, casting rays that fan out gently against the clouds. The sky is depicted with expressive, dynamic brushstrokes, suggesting a gentle breeze. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly sepia tones, creating a serene atmosphere. The composition balances darker earth tones with lighter tones in the water and sky, leading the viewer's gaze from the path through the landscape to the sky.

artworks.title: Tokio #1
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The sketch shows a busy street with buildings decorated with banners and flags. Traditional lanterns are hanging above one building, and there are signs with calligraphy displayed. Figures are seen walking on the street, including a person with an umbrella and others in distinct clothing. The scene conveys a sense of activity and cultural ambiance. The brushwork is detailed, reflecting the setting with a feeling of motion and everyday life.

artworks.title: Vous viendrez diner, ma femme soupe en ville ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: Two men are shown talking. The man on the left is standing, leaning slightly forward, holding a walking stick in his left hand, shaking hands with his right. He wears a long coat with tails, pants, and shoes. The man on the right stands upright, facing the other directly. He has short dark hair, a slightly smiling mouth, a prominent nose, and defined cheekbones. He wears a dark coat with long tails, a white shirt, a cravat, and dark trousers. He holds a top hat behind his back with his left hand and extends his right hand in greeting. The background is shaded with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Study for "The Landing of Columbus"
artworks.medium: charcoal, wash, and crayon on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a bequest of George Lothrop Bradley and Helen McHenry Bradley, 1980)
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body sketch of a nude male figure standing upright. The person has one hand on the hip and the other holding a staff. The facial features show a focused expression with eyes looking slightly to the side, a straight nose, closed lips, short dark hair combed back. There is no clothing, highlighting the natural tones of the skin. Another hand holding the staff is seen in a larger scale. The background is plain with light shading for depth, without added elements.

artworks.title: J'la croyais mieux qu'ça ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman, walking side by side. The man is on the left, wearing a dark suit with a vest, trousers, bow tie, and a top hat. He is holding a cane in his right hand and looking towards the woman. The woman, to the right, is dressed in a long dress with a bonnet covering her hair and arms crossed over her chest. The man has a prominent nose and a slight frown, with no visible hair under his hat. The woman's facial features are partly obscured by shadows cast by the bonnet, but she appears to have a pensive expression. The background features a sketch of clouds and a building with windows on the right side, suggesting an outdoor setting. The ground is lightly detailed with a cobblestone pattern.

artworks.title: Ou ça bourgeois? C'est-il a l'heure ou ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, seen from behind, interacting with another individual in a horse-drawn carriage. The standing person, possibly a woman, wears a cloak with a hood. Their left hand is on the carriage door. The person inside the carriage is a man with shaggy hair and a gaunt face. Elements of the carriage are visible, including the wheel and door with the number "297" on it. The background is lightly sketched with unclear details.

artworks.title: Salt Shanties
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden building on stilts near a waterway. The roof, crane, landscape, and surrounding structures are depicted with detailed line work characteristic of etching. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black shades on a pale beige background. In the distance, faint outlines of other structures are visible. The building's reflection in the water is depicted with delicate lines.
